description: This PHP source file defines the MetaService class within the Api\V8\Service namespace. It provides API endpoints for retrieving module and field metadata, including module lists, field definitions, and Swagger schema, with access control and data pruning features.

classes.name: MetaService
classes.description: Provides API methods for retrieving module and field metadata, and Swagger schema, with access control and data filtering.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of modules available for the current user.

methods.name: getFieldList
methods.description: Returns a list of fields for a specified module, with access control.

methods.name: checkIfUserHasModuleAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific module.

methods.name: buildFieldList
methods.description: Builds a list of field definitions for a module, pruning unwanted fields.

methods.name: pruneVardef
methods.description: Filters vardef array to include only allowed fields and sets default values.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Loads and returns the Swagger JSON schema from a file.
